data.action: 赤足抱膝蜷坐在旧皮沙发上抽烟，神情清冷疏离，烟圈在晨光中升腾
data.camera: medium shot, eye-level, intimate atmospheric realism
data.description: 【露西 · 安全屋清晨的抱膝浅思】杂乱而充满科技感的高层小公寓内，清晨惨淡的阳光透过带有雨痕的百叶窗在地板上划出道道光栅。露西身穿宽松的无袖背心和工装慢跑裤，赤足抱膝蜷缩在皮质沙发一角。烟灰缸里落着几根烟蒂，她微眯起眼睛凝视着升腾的淡蓝烟圈，整个人散发着猫一般的警惕与片刻安宁。
data.lighting: 百叶窗投射出的清冷水平光栅与屋内全息投影的幽蓝微光
data.location: 高层公寓客厅百叶窗边皮沙发
data.promptProse: Lucy curls barefoot into the apartment leather sofa in her charcoal sleeveless mesh tank and cargo joggers, holding a cyber cigarette while watching pale-blue smoke rise above the ashtray. The eye-level medium view includes rain-marked blinds and a cluttered floor behind. Weak morning sun draws horizontal bars across the floor and her knees; blue holographic glow softens the sofa's darker corner and the cigarette-holding hand.
data.title: 露西 · 安全屋清晨的抱膝浅思
